arguments.reason: Remove the boot-only per-CPU SGI self-test to fit the Recovery command line.

implementation: Use the same-model DPU pipe, display mapping and kernel fence path. Reuse the matched AdrenoMetal and Turnip bundle from 269096a9.
The SMMU ready check matches only 0x80000000 plus the bank index. Error codes 0xdead0001 through 0xdead0006 now leave the GPU copy available.

Paired USB reports direct initialization state, flip requests, CTL flush acknowledgements, copy fallback count, and latch intervals up to 100 ms. Timing measures CTL acknowledgement, not optical panel output.
build: Run sh out/main7-direct-ready-20261117/build.sh from the device repo. It uses the normal UniXNU 21H461 kernel and prelink command, local AppleKeyStoreState 8c70daf, and the retained 269096a9 addon. pack.py repacks FAT16 in the existing Samsung wrapper.
verification: Kernel build, prelink and Recovery readback passed. The packed kernel provides native_ufs_dpu_ready, native_t970_scanout_latches and the USB scanout log format.
Verified unchanged firmware shim, DTBO and DTB. Verified exact resident addon, trust bundle, ADT and Data seed.
Display unittest discovery (two tests), GOP fence-wait source check and the extracted SMMU ready check (256 bank values, six error codes and unset state) passed.

upload.result: Heimdall confirmed successful RECOVERY upload; manual reboot required.

runtime.usb: Existing pairing validated; MobileDevice session and syslog relay opened.
runtime.display: Booted to desktop; direct scanout initialized with display bank 4 (0x80000004). Owner completed the swipe test and still observed stutter.
runtime.acceptance: DPU direct scanout and USB verified. Sustained 60 FPS is not met. CTL acknowledgements cover the display path and do not distinguish compositor work from display scheduling.
